Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
1:24 AM

Aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/Ultra 5 chip. That combination handles coding, browsers and Docker without slowing down.

RAM: 16 GB minimum. 8 GB gets tight fast, so prefer a laptop where you can upgrade it later.
Screen and keyboard: A 1080p IPS screen (1920×1080), a comfortable keyboard and a weight under 1.8 kg matter more than a gaming graphics card.
Battery: Look for 8 hours or more of real use, since you'll be coding on the move.
Mac option: A MacBook Air with an M-series chip can come close to your budget on sale. It has great battery life and is very good for programming.

Do you want Windows, Linux or a Mac? I can look up current options once I know.
